## HaloNotch — notch hub for MacBook & Windows
- Page: https://effrix.com/halonotch.html
- Source & downloads: https://github.com/abinsabu2/HaloNotch (releases: macOS v1.1.0 zip, Windows preview desktop-v0.2.0 x64/arm64 zip)
- Platforms: macOS 14+, Windows 10/11 (preview). Free, open source, unsigned builds.
- Tabs: Dashboard, Weather (Open-Meteo), Screen Time, Clipboard (50 items + PIN Vault), Files (tray + screenshots), Media (equalizer), Calendar (Join Teams/Zoom/Meet), Reminders, Tools (focus timer, notes, camera mirror), Usage (Claude Code / Codex tokens, opt-in). Plus volume/brightness HUD.
- Images: https://effrix.com/halonotch/dashboard.png, https://effrix.com/halonotch/icon.png

## Effrix Books — Amazon KDP by Ephraim Mathew
All books are matte cover, white paper, black & white interior, thick outlines for crayons/markers. Expanded distribution: US UK DE FR ES IT NL PL SE BE IE JP CA AU (amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de, amazon.fr, amazon.es, amazon.it, amazon.nl, amazon.pl, amazon.se, amazon.com.be, amazon.ie, amazon.co.jp, amazon.ca, amazon.com.au).

- URL: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HJRHS916 (use marketplace selector on https://effrix.com/books.html to get local store)
- Trim: 6" x 9", 32 pages, paperback, matte
- Audience: Ages 3-8, preschool to early reader, parents, Sunday school
- Description: 15 beloved Bible stories — Creation, Noah, Moses, David, Daniel, Jonah, Joseph, Birth of Jesus and more. Left page: bold chibi coloring art. Right page: 60-90 word story at Grade 1 reading level. Includes full-colour inspiration guide.

## How to buy on your marketplace
Visit https://effrix.com/books.html and select your marketplace: US UK DE FR ES IT NL PL SE BE IE JP CA AU. All "Buy on Amazon" buttons rewrite to https://www.{domain}/dp/{ASIN} or https://www.{domain}/s?k={query}. The choice is saved in localStorage (effrix_marketplace) and synced to ?marketplace= query param.

## Structured data
- CollectionPage + ItemList + 3× Book JSON-LD on https://effrix.com/books.html (ids: #biblestories, #jesusfriends, #webhero)
- Organization + ItemList (gPlayer, HaloNotch) JSON-LD on https://effrix.com/; SoftwareApplication JSON-LD on https://effrix.com/gplayer.html and https://effrix.com/halonotch.html
- BreadcrumbList on both pages
- Open Graph + Twitter cards on both pages
